info.title: Rever API
info.summary: Website intelligence for AI agents: 40 pay-per-call endpoints ($0.001 to $0.05) for scraping, SEO, security, DNS, design and crypto due diligence.
info.description: 40 website-analysis endpoints for AI agents, priced $0.001 to $0.05 per call: page to markdown/text, metadata, contacts, social links, sitemap, robots.txt, broken links, SEO and AI-readiness audits, security headers, HTTPS, DNS, email security, WHOIS/RDAP, Wayback history, tech stack, trackers, company info, brand kit, design tokens, screenshots, UI-recreation prompts and a crypto project website trust check. All are POST with JSON {"url": "..."}. Agents pay with x402 v2 (exact scheme, USDC on Base eip155:8453): the first call returns 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. You are never charged for a failed call. Full guide: https://www.aypiai.online/llms-full.txt

post.summary: Generate a UI-recreation prompt from a URL
post.description: Use when a user wants to clone, copy or recreate the design of an existing website. Returns a text prompt (not code); pass it to a code model to generate the UI. Takes 10-30 seconds.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page to recreate.

prompt.description: Design brief to give to a code-generation model.

remaining.description: Generations left on the access key (access-key payments only).

PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: x402 settlement receipt (base64 JSON), on x402 payments.

402.description: Payment required or rejected. x402: decode the base64 JSON PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (accepts: scheme exact, network eip155:8453, asset USDC, amount 250000, payTo) and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

502.description: Screenshot or model failed. The payment or generation is released; retry with the same hash/key.

get.summary: Generations left on an access key

post.summary: Extract a website's design tokens as JSON
post.description: Extract a website's design tokens as JSON: color palette with roles (hex), fonts and type scale, spacing, border radii, shadows, light/dark mode, and a ready-to-use Tailwind theme extension. Takes 5-20 s. Price: $0.02 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Screenshot any public web page
post.description: Screenshot any public web page. Returns a JPEG (base64 data URL plus a hosted URL). Options: width (320-2560, default 1280), height (300-8000, default 900), fullPage (boolean). Takes 3-15 s. Price: $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Detect the technologies behind a website
post.description: Detect the technologies behind a website: framework (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, React...), site builder (Webflow, Framer, Lovable, Shopify, WordPress...), hosting/CDN (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare...), CSS (Tailwind, Bootstrap), analytics, payments, auth and support tools, with evidence. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get a website's brand kit in one call
post.description: Get a website's brand kit in one call: the site's own logo (URL plus inline SVG when available, not customer logos), favicon, theme color, color palette ranked by usage, brand CSS variables and fonts, read from its HTML and stylesheets. Fast (1-4 s). Price: $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs
post.description: Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs: main content only (no nav, footer, scripts, cookie banners), with headings, lists, links, images, tables and code blocks preserved. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get a page's metadata
post.description: Get a page's metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, Open Graph and Twitter card (including preview image), icons, RSS feeds, JSON-LD types, H1s, link and word counts. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Extract contact details from a web page
post.description: Extract contact details from a web page: email addresses (including mailto links and [at]-obfuscated ones), phone numbers (tel links and visible numbers) and postal addresses from structured data. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Find a website's social media profiles
post.description: Find a website's social media profiles: X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Discord, Telegram, Medium, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Farcaster and more, from its links. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: List every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with
post.description: List every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with nofollow flags and the external domains linked to. Up to 500 links. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Check the links on a web page for broken ones
post.description: Check the links on a web page for broken ones: requests up to 40 unique links in parallel and reports each status code, broken links (4xx/5xx/unreachable) and redirects. Takes 2-10 s. Price: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps
post.description: Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps: finds sitemaps via robots.txt and common paths, follows sitemap indexes (up to 5 children) and returns URLs with lastmod dates. Optional limit (default 1000, max 5000). Takes 1-6 s. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Read and parse a website's robots.txt
post.description: Read and parse a website's robots.txt: user-agent groups with allow/disallow rules, declared sitemaps, and which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...) are blocked from the whole site. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Grade a website's HTTP security headers (A-F)
post.description: Grade a website's HTTP security headers (A-F): HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, plus leaked server/version headers, with a fix hint for each missing one. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Check a site's HTTPS setup
post.description: Check a site's HTTPS setup: whether http:// redirects to https://, HSTS and preload readiness, final URL, and mixed content (insecure http:// scripts, styles, images or iframes on the https page). Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10)
post.description: Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10): status code, Location and server for each hop, final URL, and loop detection. Useful for link unshortening and SEO migrations. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get the raw HTTP response headers of any URL, with status code, final URL after redirects
post.description: Get the raw HTTP response headers of any URL, with status code, final URL after redirects and response time. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Is this website up? Returns up/down, HTTP status, response time in ms, final URL and conte
post.description: Is this website up? Returns up/down, HTTP status, response time in ms, final URL and content type. Cheapest uptime check for agents. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Detect a web page's language
post.description: Detect a web page's language: html lang attribute, Content-Language header, og:locale, hreflang alternates (other language versions) and a guess from the visible text. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Text statistics for a web page's visible content
post.description: Text statistics for a web page's visible content: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, Flesch reading-ease score and top keywords (stop words removed). Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Extract all structured data from a web page
post.description: Extract all structured data from a web page: every JSON-LD block parsed (Organization, Product, Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb, Event...), microdata item types and RDFa types. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared)
post.description: Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared): og:image and twitter:image with declared size and alt text, or the first large page image as a fallback. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml)
post.description: Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml) and return the latest items from the first one: title, link, date, summary. Takes 1-5 s. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: List the images on a web page with absolute URL, alt text, declared width/height and lazy-
post.description: List the images on a web page with absolute URL, alt text, declared width/height and lazy-loading, plus counts of images missing alt text (accessibility/SEO). Up to 300 images. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get the heading outline of a web page (H1-H6 in document order) with counts per level and
post.description: Get the heading outline of a web page (H1-H6 in document order) with counts per level and structure warnings (no H1, several H1s, skipped levels). Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Quick on-page SEO audit with a 0-100 score
post.description: Quick on-page SEO audit with a 0-100 score: title and meta description length, H1, canonical, lang, viewport, noindex, Open Graph, image alt text, structured data, HTTPS, robots.txt and sitemap, with a fix for each failed check. Takes 2-5 s. Price: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get the best favicon/icon for a website
post.description: Get the best favicon/icon for a website: the largest declared icon (apple-touch-icon, SVG, sized PNGs), all candidates with sizes, and whether /favicon.ico exists. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.001 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: DNS lookup for a website's domain
post.description: DNS lookup for a website's domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and CAA records, via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Pass a URL or bare hostname. Fast (under 2 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Check a domain's email setup and spoofing protection
post.description: Check a domain's email setup and spoofing protection: MX records and email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho...), SPF, DMARC policy and common DKIM selectors, with a 0-100 score. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS)
post.description: Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS): registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, domain age in days, status flags and nameservers. Useful for trust and fraud checks. Takes 1-4 s. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rul
post.description: How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, whether content renders without JavaScript, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 manifests, with a 0-100 score and fixes. Takes 2-5 s. Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normaliz
post.description: Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normalized, with title and word count. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: List the forms on a web page
post.description: List the forms on a web page: action URL, method, fields (name, type, label, required) and a guess of each form's purpose (login, signup, newsletter, search, contact, payment). Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Detect analytics, ad and tracking scripts on a web page (Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Met
post.description: Detect analytics, ad and tracking scripts on a web page (Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar, Clarity, Segment, Mixpanel, HubSpot, Plausible...), cookie-consent tools and all third-party script domains. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.003 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Company profile from its website in one call
post.description: Company profile from its website in one call: name, description, logo, founding date, address, phones, emails, social profiles and links to about/contact/careers/pricing pages, from structured data and the page. Takes 1-4 s. Price: $0.005 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Find the important pages of a website from its home page links
post.description: Find the important pages of a website from its home page links: about, contact, pricing, careers, blog, docs, login, signup, team, privacy and terms. Saves agents from crawling. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Page performance basics without a browser
post.description: Page performance basics without a browser: time to first byte, HTML size, compression, caching headers, CDN, and counts of scripts, stylesheets, images, fonts and iframes, with inline script/style size. Fast (1-3 s). Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Internet Archive history of a website
post.description: Internet Archive history of a website: first and latest Wayback Machine snapshot (date and link) and how long the site has existed online. Useful for trust checks and research. Takes 1-5 s. Price: $0.002 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

post.summary: Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact
post.description: Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact: domain age (RDAP) and first archive date, HTTPS/security, socials (X, Telegram, Discord, GitHub), docs/whitepaper, team page, audit firms mentioned, contract addresses on the page (optionally verifies yours), scam phrases and wallet-drainer signals (seed-phrase inputs), template/free-hosting signs. Returns a 0-100 trust score, red and green flags. Heuristics, not financial advice. Takes 3-8 s. Price: $0.02 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

contract.description: Optional token contract address to verify it is published on the site

post.summary: Is this token safe to buy? One call returns a 0-100 safety score and verdict for any token
post.description: Is this token safe to buy? One call returns a 0-100 safety score and verdict for any token contract (Ethereum, Base, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, Solana): honeypot test (can you sell?), buy/sell tax, mint/pause/blacklist/owner powers, proxy and open-source status, liquidity and LP lock, holder concentration, pair age, volume, plus a check of the project's website (domain age, socials, scam signals). Auto-detects the chain. Heuristics from public on-chain data, not financial advice. Takes 2-8 s. Price: $0.02 per call via x402 (USDC on Base).

address.description: Token contract address (EVM 0x... or Solana mint)

chain.description: Optional: ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche or solana. Auto-detected if omitted.
